This unified approach allows enterprises to streamline their AI stack and consolidate procurement costs, as demonstrated by firms like Novo Nordisk, which significantly reduced clinical reporting times.

articles.title: OpenAI's Deployment Simulation Extends Pre-Deployment Risk Assessment to Agentic Coding Through Simulated Tool Calls - MarkTechPost
articles.summary_en: OpenAI has introduced 'Deployment Simulation,' a safety method that evaluates new models by replaying actual user traffic to estimate failure rates. This approach complements traditional testing by providing representative data on how models perform in real-world contexts, though it is limited to risks appearing in at least 1 in 200,000 messages.

articles.title: Anthropic to meet White House officials over AI tool suspension - BBC
articles.summary_en: Anthropic executives are set to meet with U.S. Commerce Department officials to address a government-mandated suspension of its 'Fable 5' and 'Mythos 5' AI tools. The government blocked public access due to national security concerns regarding potential jailbreak vulnerabilities in these highly capable models.

articles.title: North Korea Advances AI Research Using Aging Nvidia Chips Despite Sanctions - Koreabizwire
articles.summary_en: Despite stringent international sanctions, North Korea continues to advance its artificial intelligence research efforts by utilizing aging Nvidia hardware. The state’s ability to conduct AI development despite restricted access to modern semiconductor technology underscores ongoing challenges in enforcing global tech export controls.

articles.title: HPE tightens Nvidia ties in AI stack, integrates Juniper - Constellation Research
articles.summary_en: HPE has expanded its enterprise AI infrastructure by integrating Nvidia’s latest server technologies and Juniper’s networking portfolio to create a self-driving, high-efficiency data center stack. The update features advanced observability tools and metadata optimization that HPE claims can reduce AI token response times by 20x.

articles.title: ASUS Launches ExpertCenter Pro ET900N G3 Built on NVIDIA DGX Station Architecture - ASUS Pressroom
articles.summary_en: ASUS has released the ExpertCenter Pro ET900N G3, a deskside supercomputer utilizing the NVIDIA GB300 Grace Blackwell Ultra chip to provide data-center-level AI performance locally. With 748GB of coherent memory and 20 PFLOPS of performance, it is designed to support the training of models with up to 1 trillion parameters without relying on cloud infrastructure.

articles.title: SearchLeak vulnerability allows data theft from Microsoft 365 Copilot Enterprise - SC Media
articles.summary_en: Researchers at Varonis identified a critical three-stage vulnerability chain, dubbed SearchLeak, that allowed attackers to exfiltrate sensitive data from Microsoft 365 Copilot by exploiting Bing's image search feature. Microsoft has successfully addressed the flaw, which previously enabled data theft through specially crafted URLs and HTML rendering exploits.

articles.title: Meta Unwinds Manus Acquisition and Faces Internal Revolt as AI Strategy Takes Its Toll - AI Insider
articles.summary_en: Meta is unwinding its $2 billion acquisition of Manus following a divestiture order from Chinese regulators citing national security concerns. Simultaneously, the company faces internal unrest as 1,600 employees protest a massive new Applied AI unit that monitors staff activity for training data collection.

articles.title: It Is Trivially Easy to Use Reddit to Manipulate AI Search, Research Suggests - 404 Media
articles.summary_en: Cornell University research reveals that AI search agents can be manipulated by as few as 13 words of strategically placed, inauthentic content on platforms like Reddit and Wikipedia. This vulnerability highlights the growing threat of AI-engine optimization (AEO), where brands create spam content to influence the information retrieved and cited by LLMs.

articles.title: New York’s IT office partners with AWS for cloud and AI services, strategy saving taxpayers $58M - StateScoop
articles.summary_en: New York’s Office of Information Technology Services has partnered with AWS to centralize cloud and AI services, a move that has already generated $58 million in taxpayer savings. The initiative aims to streamline procurement and provide advanced AI tools to over 100,000 state employees.

articles.title: Chinese Hackers Target Medical, Military, and AI Research in North America - SecurityWeek
articles.summary_en: Chinese hackers are reportedly targeting critical sectors in North America, including medical, military, and artificial intelligence research, according to recent security reports.

articles.title: Amazon security research reportedly led to the White House’s Anthropic Fable ban - The Verge
articles.summary_en: A White House export control directive blocking Anthropic’s Fable and Mythos models was reportedly triggered by Amazon's security research, which claimed the models could be exploited for cyberattacks. Anthropic has disputed the findings, arguing that the models were not compromised by a true 'jailbreak' and that similar vulnerabilities exist in other industry models.

articles.title: IMDA and Microsoft sign AI safety MOU - Let's Data Science
articles.summary_en: Singapore's IMDA and Microsoft have signed an MOU to collaborate on AI safety, focusing on research into agentic AI and multilingual safety standards. The partnership will produce shared evaluation benchmarks and a joint white paper on policy frameworks for trusted access to frontier AI models.
